text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: What do you mean by repeating this proverb concerning the land of Israel, “The parents have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge”?
text_cn: “在以色列地区内，你们有这样流行的俗话说：‘祖先吃了酸葡萄，而子孙的牙酸倒’这话有什么意思？

text_en: As I live, says the Lord God , this proverb shall no more be used by you in Israel.
text_cn: 我指着我的生命起誓 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 在以色列决不能再容许这俗话流行。

text_en: Know that all lives are mine; the life of the parent as well as the life of the child is mine: it is only the person who sins that shall die.
text_cn: 所有的生命都属于我，祖先的生命与子孙的生命全属于我；谁犯罪，谁丧亡。

text_en: If a man is righteous and does what is lawful and right—
text_cn: 一个人若正义，必行公道正义的事。

text_en: if he does not eat upon the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor’s wife or approach a woman during her menstrual period,
text_cn: 他不上山吃祭物，不举目瞻仰以色列家族的偶像，不污辱近人的妻子，不接近经期中的妇女，

text_en: does not oppress anyone, but restores to the debtor his pledge, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with a garment,
text_cn: 不欺压任何人，清还债户的抵押，不抢劫，施给饥饿者食物，给赤身者衣穿，

text_en: does not take advance or accrued interest, withholds his hand from iniquity, executes true justice between contending parties,
text_cn: 不放重利，不取息金，使自己的手远避邪恶，在人与人之间执行公正的审断，

text_en: follows my statutes, and is careful to observe my ordinances, acting faithfully—such a one is righteous; he shall surely live, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 遵行我的法度，谨守我的诫命，行事忠信：这样的人才是正义的，必得生存 —— 吾主的断语 ——

text_en: If he has a son who is violent, a shedder of blood,
text_cn: 倘若这人生了一个儿子，性暴好杀，只行这类的事；

text_en: who does any of these things (though his father does none of them), who eats upon the mountains, defiles his neighbor’s wife,
text_cn: 对上述的事不但不作，反而上山吃祭物，污辱近人的妻子，

text_en: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not restore the pledge, lifts up his eyes to the idols, commits abomination,
text_cn: 欺压贫穷无告的人，抢劫，不清还抵押，举目瞻仰偶像，行丑恶之事，

text_en: takes advance or accrued interest; shall he then live? He shall not. He has done all these abominable things; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon himself.
text_cn: 放重利，取利息：这样的人决不能生存，因为他行了这些丑事，必要丧亡，他的血债必由他自己来负。

text_en: But if this man has a son who sees all the sins that his father has done, considers, and does not do likewise,
text_cn: 倘若这人生了一个儿子，这儿子虽看见了他父亲所行的一切罪过，但考虑之后，却未依照去做；

text_en: who does not eat upon the mountains or lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, does not defile his neighbor’s wife,
text_cn: 不在山上吃祭物，不举目瞻仰以色列家族的偶像，不污辱近人的妻子，

text_en: does not wrong anyone, exacts no pledge, commits no robbery, but gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with a garment,
text_cn: 不欺压，不索取抵押，不抢劫，施给饥饿者食物，给赤身者衣穿，

text_en: withholds his hand from iniquity, takes no advance or accrued interest, observes my ordinances, and follows my statutes; he shall not die for his father’s iniquity; he shall surely live.
text_cn: 使自己的手戒绝邪恶，不取重利和利息，谨守我的法律，遵行我的法度：这人必不因他父亲的罪而丧亡，必得生存。

text_en: As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what is not good among his people, he dies for his iniquity.
text_cn: 至于他的父亲，由于暴行，抢劫，在自己人民中从未行过善。看，他必因自己的罪而丧亡。

text_en: Yet you say, “Why should not the son suffer for the iniquity of the father? ” When the son has done what is lawful and right, and has been careful to observe all my statutes, he shall surely live.
text_cn: 你们或问：儿子为什么不承担父亲的罪过？因为儿子遵行法律和正义，谨守了我一切法度，而一一遵行，他必得生存。

text_en: The person who sins shall die. A child shall not suffer for the iniquity of a parent, nor a parent suffer for the iniquity of a child; the righteousness of the righteous shall be his own, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be his own.
text_cn: 谁犯罪，谁就该丧亡；儿子不承当父亲的罪过，父亲不承当儿子的罪过；义人的正义归于义人自己，恶人的邪恶也归于恶人自己。

text_en: But if the wicked turn away from all their sins that they have committed and keep all my statutes and do what is lawful and right, they shall surely live; they shall not die.
text_cn: 若恶人悔改，远离所犯的罪过，遵守我的法度，遵行我的法律和正义，必得生存，不至丧亡。

text_en: None of the transgressions that they have committed shall be remembered against them; for the righteousness that they have done they shall live.
text_cn: 他所行的一切邪恶必被遗忘；他必因所行的正义而得生存。

text_en: Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, says the Lord God , and not rather that they should turn from their ways and live?
text_cn: 我岂能喜欢恶人的丧亡？ —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 我岂不更喜欢他离开旧道而得生存？

text_en: But when the righteous turn away from their righteousness and commit iniquity and do the same abominable things that the wicked do, shall they live? None of the righteous deeds that they have done shall be remembered; for the treachery of which they are guilty and the sin they have committed, they shall die.
text_cn: 若义人离弃了正义而行恶，一如恶人所惯行的丑恶，他岂能生存？他行过的正义必被遗忘，因为他背信违约，犯了罪过，必要丧亡。

text_en: Yet you say, “The way of the Lord is unfair. ” Hear now, O house of Israel: Is my way unfair? Is it not your ways that are unfair?
text_cn: 你们或说：上主的作法不公平！以色列家族，请听我说：是我的作法不公平吗？岂不是你们的作法不公平？

text_en: When the righteous turn away from their righteousness and commit iniquity, they shall die for it; for the iniquity that they have committed they shall die.
text_cn: 若是义人离弃正义而行恶，因而丧亡，是因为他所行的恶而丧亡。

text_en: Again, when the wicked turn away from the wickedness they have committed and do what is lawful and right, they shall save their life.
text_cn: 若恶人远离他所行的恶事，而遵行法律和正义，必能保全自己的生命，

text_en: Because they considered and turned away from all the transgressions that they had committed, they shall surely live; they shall not die.
text_cn: 因为他考虑之后，离弃了所行的一切恶事，他必生存，不至丧亡。

text_en: Yet the house of Israel says, “The way of the Lord is unfair. ” O house of Israel, are my ways unfair? Is it not your ways that are unfair?
text_cn: 若以色列家族还说：吾主的作法不公平。以色列家族！是我的作法不公平吗？岂不是你们的作法不公平？

text_en: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, all of you according to your ways, says the Lord God . Repent and turn from all your transgressions; otherwise iniquity will be your ruin.
text_cn: 以色列家族！我要照各人的行为裁判你们 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 你们应回心转意，离开你们的一切罪恶，避免它们再做你们犯罪的绊脚石。

text_en: Cast away from you all the transgressions that you have committed against me, and get yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! Why will you die, O house of Israel?
text_cn: 由你们身上抛弃一切得罪我的恶行吧！你们应改造一个新心，一种新的精神！以色列家族，为何你们偏要丧亡？

text_en: For I have no pleasure in the death of anyone, says the Lord God . Turn, then, and live.
text_cn: 因为我不喜欢任何人丧亡 —— 吾主上主的断语 —— 你们回心转意吧！你们必得生存！
